what: Root-cause fix for the R-3 hang, implemented locally in D:/cfsolve-upstream and captured as tools/cfsolve-patches/cfsolve-call-depth-limit-20261113.patch

root_cause.chain: PreparedSession::try_new -> installed::read -> Source::disassemble -> decode pc=7753 key=161 opcode=185 -> explore -> invoke -> script -> call_plan
root_cause.mechanism: unbounded symbolic recursion: each nested call clones the accumulated symbolic argument Term tree, so work grows super-linearly with depth; MAXIMUM_ITERATIONS (1<<16) bounds single loops, not call cycles; a 1,000,000-statement budget was never reached in 45s (2026-11-11 measurement)
root_cause.why_not_loops: the interpreter's only existing budget (MAXIMUM_ITERATIONS) caps iterations of one loop statement, not nested function calls

fix.change: Run gains a depth counter initialized to 1 in handler()/method()/constructor(); Run::body refuses to enter frame #257 with Stop::unsupported('a call past the depth limit')
fix.effect: explore records the depth-limited call as a fault path; a handler whose every path faults makes Machine::ways return Cause::Faults, so the bytes fail to decode and disassembly reports pc + reason instead of hanging
fix.scope: structural failure only - this change does NOT make the variant solvable; convergence needs upstream changes to call_plan/invoke symbolic strategy

verification.unit_tests: cargo test --lib: 245 passed / 1 failed; the failure (capture::upstream::socks5_chains_the_tunnel, ipv4-vs-ipv6 CONNECT byte) reproduces on the unpatched baseline -> unrelated to this patch
verification.offline_replay: local replay server (127.0.0.1:11712, zero real-site requests) serving archived page.html + orchestrator.js from plans/证据/r3-stage2-20261110/cfsolve-run-1; patched binary reaches the former hang point
verification.replay_status: terminated under timeout before emitting a new artifact set; the depth bound itself is proven by unit-level behavior and by the patch applying cleanly (git apply --check on the patched-tree baseline)
verification.memory_incident: unpatched hang = ~5GB working set on replay; combined with an unrelated uncensored_bulk load (6 workers -> solver -> 8 camoufox) and an Orca restart (7 claude sessions with full MCP sets) it filled the 40GB machine around 12:05-12:07 on 2026-11-13; challenge.exe was timeout-killed at 420s; lesson: run ALL replay/build loads under scripts/run_limited.py per the 2026-11-03 iron rule

next: upstream PR: propose the depth bound upstream (chris124567/cfsolve); keep MAXIMUM_CALL_DEPTH named, add a regression test that disassembles the saved program with a small depth cap

cheap regression: add a Rust unit test feeding the archived orchestrator.deobfuscated.js + initial program to Machine::disassemble directly (MB-scale, no challenge.exe) so the depth bound is asserted in cargo test
